### Borea v0.6.15

A patch release for StarMap 0.5 and for scrolling in Discover. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixes

- StarMap 0.5.0 to 0.5.3 fails in its own clean up after you close the game. Borea no longer shows "The game closed unexpectedly" for that at the next start, because your session ended normally; it writes the error to its log instead. A crash of the game or a mod still shows as before. StarMap 0.5.4 fixes the error itself.
- Scrolling a long list in Discover allocates about a third less memory, because a row builds its install, remove and error parts only when it shows them.

Full changelog: [v0.6.14...v0.6.15](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.14...v0.6.15)
